cues.en: Boeing 777, one of the biggest and most modern aircraft in the world, just vanished without a trace. It can't. Everything lost leaves a trace. There are mysteries in the world and then there is the story of MH370.
cues.zh: 波音777，世界上最大、最先进的客机之一，就这样凭空消失了。这绝不可能。凡事发生必留痕迹。世界上有各种未解之谜，但还有一个谜团，叫做MH370。

cues.en: This is a story so full of questions and theories that it's almost impossible to tell it without resorting to pure speculation. This is the reason I have refrained from covering it up until now, but since at the time of this video's release it's gone 10 years since 239 people disappeared without a trace, I've decided to make an exception.
cues.zh: 这个故事充斥着太多谜团与假说，如果不靠纯粹的推测，几乎无法讲述。这也是我此前一直避而不谈的原因，但视频发布之际，距239人离奇失踪已过去整整十年，我决定破例一次。

cues.en: This story is created with one goal and one goal only, and that is to persuade the authorities to restart the search for the missing Boeing 777. And with that, hopefully also provide some closure to the families, some of which I've been in contact with before making this video. I will today share with you new potential evidence based on a technology that has been enhanced and refined over the last few years, to the point where it now possibly can provide new clues to where this aircraft finally ended up.
cues.zh: 制作这个故事只有一个目的，就是敦促有关部门重启对这架失联波音777的搜寻。同时也希望借此给家属们一个交代，在制作视频前我也与其中一些家属取得了联系。今天我将向大家分享一些潜在的新证据，它们基于一项在过去几年中不断精进优化的技术，如今该技术或许能为飞机最终的坠落地点提供新线索。

cues.en: This is the story of Malaysian Airlines flight 370 as far as we know it. On the 7th of March 2014 a crew from Malaysian Airlines checked in for a night duty which was to take them from Kuala Lumpur International Airport in Malaysia up to Beijing International in China.
cues.zh: 这就是目前我们所知道的马来西亚航空370号航班的故事。2014年3月7日，一组马航机组人员签到执行夜航任务，计划从马来西亚吉隆坡国际机场飞往中国北京首都国际机场。

cues.en: Except for the late start time, it was supposed to be a quite nice duty with a calculated flight time of only 5 hours and 34 minutes, meaning that they would eventually be finished in Beijing around mid-morning the following day. The captain of the flight arrived first and signed in at the Malaysian Airlines crew room at local time 22.50. He was unfollowed by his colleague, the first officer, around 25 minutes later.
cues.zh: 除了出发时间较晚之外，这本该是一次相当轻松的任务，计算飞行时间仅为5小时34分钟，这意味着他们最终将在第二天上午中段左右到达北京。这次航班的机长率先抵达，于当地时间22:50在马来西亚航空机组休息室签到。大约25分钟后，他的同事、副驾驶也随后到达。

cues.en: This was planned as a training flight for the first officer since he was completing a transition type course over from the Airbus A330 to the Boeing 777 which they would be flying on this flight. The training had gone really well up until this point and if everything went fine on this flight he would be recommended for final line check by the captain for the following duty. Having said that, this was the first time that these two pilots were planned to fly together which might explain why the captain had turned up a little bit earlier.
cues.zh: 按计划，这是一次针对副驾驶的训练飞行，因为他正在完成从空客A330到波音777机型的过渡改装训练，而他们本次航班执飞的就是波音777。到目前为止，训练进展得非常顺利，如果这次飞行一切顺利，机长将建议他在接下来的任务中进行最终航线检查。话虽如此，这是这两位飞行员第一次被安排共同飞行，这或许可以解释为什么机长会早到了一会儿。

cues.en: You see, it's pretty common for us instructors to do so if we need to review someone's training file for example before the flight to check out if there's any areas that might require special attention. In any case, once the first officer had also signed in, the two pilots proceeded by going through the pre-flight briefing which from what they could see looked pretty straightforward.
cues.zh: 你看，对于我们教员来说，这样做是很常见的，比如如果我们需要在飞行前查阅某人的训练档案，以确认是否有需要特别关注的地方。无论如何，一旦副驾驶也完成了签到，两位飞行员便接着进行航前简报，从他们目前了解的情况来看，一切都相当顺利。

cues.en: The weather in Kuala Lumpur was generally nice and dominated by a subtropical high pressure centered over Thailand and the weather at their destination Beijing also looked quite good from what they could see. The only potential issue was that about two thirds down the route they would be passing through a pretty strong jet stream with high winds which could cause a bit of turbulence but apart from that it was looking pretty straightforward.
cues.zh: 吉隆坡的天气总体不错，主要受盘踞在泰国上空的一个副热带高压控制，而从他们能看到的情况判断，目的地北京的天气也相当理想。唯一潜在的问题是，航程大约三分之二处会经过一股相当强劲的高空急流，风速很大，可能带来一些颠簸，但除此之外，一切看起来都相当顺利。

cues.en: With that in mind, and no notums affecting the flight either, the pilots then turned their attention to the flight plan. There were two alternates listed for Beijing and taking into consideration both of these, the pilots decided on a final fuel of 49,100 kilos, which was in line with the expected amount for this flight, neither substantially more nor less than required. This fuel would give the aircraft an approximate endurance of 7 hours and 31 minutes, around 2 hours longer than the anticipated flight time,
cues.zh: 考虑到这一点，加上也没有任何NOTAM影响航班，飞行员随后把注意力转向了飞行计划。北京列出了两个备降机场，综合考量这两者后，飞行员最终确定加油量为49,100公斤，这与该航班的预期加油量相符，既没有明显多于也没有明显少于所需。这些燃油能让飞机获得大约7小时31分钟的续航能力，比预计飞行时间多出约2小时，

cues.en: And that will of course become very important in this story. So, who were the pilots that were going to be in charge of this flight then? Well, the captain was a 53-year-old with a 33-year great track record in Malaysia Airlines. He was married with three children and on his spare time he was involved in a local opposition party, helped deliver groceries to elderly and tinker with some home electronics. He had also started a YouTube channel which
cues.zh: 而这在本故事中当然会变得非常重要。那么，执飞这趟航班的飞行员是谁呢？机长是一位53岁的资深飞行员，在马来西亚航空拥有33年的出色飞行记录。他已婚，育有三个孩子，业余时间参与当地一个反对党的事务，帮忙给老人送食品杂货，还摆弄一些家用电子产品。他还开设了一个YouTube频道，

cues.en: by the way still there, where he showed how to mend certain home appliances and also crucially where he showed off his home simulator which he had built to be able to practice his trade at home. This simulator would later be investigated thoroughly. It had been erased weeks before the flight but the investigator still found some manually entered waypoints of interest in a backup memory but without it proving to be anything conclusive.
cues.zh: 顺便说一句，这个频道至今仍在，他在上面演示如何修理某些家用电器，更重要的是，他还在上面展示了自己在家搭建的模拟器，用来在家里练习飞行技术。这个模拟器后来受到了彻底调查。它在航班发生前几周就被清除了数据，但调查人员仍在备份内存中发现了一些手动输入的可疑航路点，不过这些并未能证明任何确凿的结论。

cues.en: In any case, the captain had stable finances, no known illnesses and was recorded as a solid, reliable member of his community. In terms of his aviation career, it had started when he was accepted into a sponsored program for Malaysian Airlines already back in 1981. He completed his licenses and then started flying for them back in 1983.
cues.zh: 无论如何，机长的财务状况稳定，没有已知的疾病，并且在社区里被公认为踏实可靠的成员。就他的航空生涯而言，早在1981年，他就被马来西亚航空的一个赞助项目录取，以此开启了飞行生涯。他考取了飞行执照，并在1983年开始为该航空公司驾驶飞机。

cues.en: He then worked his way up the ranks, starting on the Fokker F27 and then the 737-200, Airbus A300 and finally he got his first command on the Fokker 50. This was then followed by command on the 737-400 and the Airbus A330 until actually on my birthday, the 22nd of September 1998, he received his command on the Boeing 777, which he then continued to operate until the day of his flight. His...
cues.zh: 随后他一路晋升，最初驾驶 Fokker F27，接着是 737-200、Airbus A300，最后在 Fokker 50 上首次担任机长。之后他相继担任了 737-400 和 Airbus A330 的机长，直到1998年9月22日（实际上正是我的生日），他获得了 Boeing 777 的机长资格，并一直驾驶该机型直到出事当天。他的……

cues.en: Good track record and seniority eventually gave him the opportunity to also become a type rating instructor as well as an examiner on this type and it was in this capacity that he was going to operate Malaysian Airlines flight 370 on this evening. He had a total experience of just over 18 400 hours and 8659 of those had been flown on the Boeing 777. The first officer was 27 years old and single.
cues.zh: 良好的飞行记录和资历最终让他有机会成为该机型的型别等级教员兼考官，当晚他正是以这种身份执行马来西亚航空370号航班的。他的总飞行经验略超 18,400 小时，其中 8,659 小时是在 Boeing 777 上飞的。副驾驶27岁，未婚。

cues.en: He had also been accepted into the airline as a cadet pilot, started in 2008 and he had been flying initially on the Boeing 77-400. He had then changed over to the Airbus A330 fleet in 2012 and then onto the Boeing 777 in November 2013, just a few months before this flight and this was obviously why he was still in training. He had a total experience of just over 2800 hours and very little, only 39 hours on the type.
cues.zh: 他也是作为学员飞行员被航空公司录用的，始于2008年，最初驾驶 Boeing 737-400。随后他在2012年转入 Airbus A330 机队，又于2013年11月（即这次航班几个月前）转入 Boeing 777 机队，这显然就是他仍在接受训练的原因。他的总飞行经验略超 2,800 小时，且在该机型上的经验非常少，只有 39 小时。

cues.en: There is not much more mentioned about the first officer in the final report except that he was known as a nice person with stable economy and no recent major changes in his life. Now given the vast difference in experience, seniority and the fact that this was a training flight it can be easily assumed that the power gradient in the cockpit would have been quite steep but nothing indicated any personal issues between these two colleagues.
cues.zh: 最终报告中对副驾驶的更多描述不多，只知道他为人不错、经济状况稳定，近期生活没有重大变化。考虑到两人在经验和资历上的巨大差距，以及这是一次训练飞行，很容易推断驾驶舱里的权力梯度会相当陡峭，但没有任何迹象表明这两位同事之间存在个人问题。

cues.en: Both of them had also received more than the required rest before the flight and their licenses and medicals were all up to date. When the pilots had completed their pre-flight preparation and training briefing, they walked over to their 10 cabin crew members that they were scheduled to operate together with. This was a vastly experienced crew with the most junior attendant having flown for 13 years and the most senior over 35 years, so the briefing would have been pretty quick and efficient.
cues.zh: 两人在飞行前也都获得了超过规定时长的休息，执照和体检也都有效。飞行员完成航前准备和训练简报后，走向按计划一起执行任务的10名客舱乘务员。这是一支经验非常丰富的机组，最年轻的乘务员已飞行13年，最资深的超过35年，所以简报应该会相当快速高效。

cues.en: After they were finished they all walked together out to the aircraft that was being prepared for them by the ground crew outside. It was a majestic Boeing 777-200ER equipped with two Rolls-Royce Trent 892 Bravo turbofan engines and it was in perfect working condition according to the tech log. The only point of interest was that the flight crew oxygen cylinder had been topped up just prior to the flight but this was a routine maintenance thing.
cues.zh: 结束后，他们一起走到外面由地面人员正在准备的飞机旁。那是一架雄伟的波音777-200ER，配备两台罗尔斯·罗伊斯Trent 892 Bravo涡扇发动机，根据技术日志，它处于完美的工作状态。唯一值得注意的是，飞行机组氧气瓶在飞行前刚刚补充过，但这只是例行维护。

cues.en: Now, there are numerous systems aboard this aircraft that will become important for this story, and in order to explain it I will have to become quite technical in some places, but also that's kind of what we do here on the channel. Anyway, the two pilots had decided that the first officer was going to be pilot flying for this flight, meaning that he immediately started completing the pre-flight preparation as soon as he arrived to the cockpit.
cues.zh: 现在，这架飞机上有许多系统对这个故事至关重要，为了解释清楚，我不得不在某些地方讲得非常技术化，但这其实也是我们这个频道一贯的风格。言归正传，两位飞行员决定由副驾驶担任本次飞行的操纵机长，这意味着他一进入驾驶舱就开始着手进行航前准备。

cues.en: This included inputting flight information, like the flight number and the airline info into the FMCCDU, which he did at time 23, 56 and 8 seconds. Now you might wonder how we can know that so exactly, and this has to do with a system that will play an incredibly important role here, the Aircraft Communications Addressing and Reporting System, more commonly referred to as ACARS.
cues.zh: 这包括将飞行信息（比如航班号和航空公司信息）输入到 FMCCDU 中，他是在 23 点 56 分 08 秒完成这一操作的。你可能想知道我们怎么能知道得这么精确，这就跟一个在此扮演极其重要角色的系统有关——飞机通信寻址与报告系统，通常被称为 ACARS。

cues.en: This is a digital data link system which connects data providers on the ground directly to the aircraft via either VHF or satellite communications. It enables people on the ground to send things like updated weather, flight plans and even make calls or send messages directly to the aircraft when it's airborne and the part of this system which is going to be most important here is the satellite communications or SATCOM system.
cues.zh: 这是一个数字数据链系统，它通过甚高频（VHF）或卫星通信将地面的数据提供商与飞机直接连接起来。它能让地面人员在飞机飞行时发送更新的天气、飞行计划等信息，甚至可以直接向飞机拨打电话或发送消息，而这个系统中最关键的部分将是卫星通信（SATCOM）系统。

cues.en: The aircraft system booted up and established a link through the SATCOM at time 23.54 and about 1 minute and 20 seconds later it captured the first officer's inputs as I just mentioned before. This showed that the system worked fine in the beginning of this flight and it's worth noting here that the system uses two different satellite antennas depending on if the aircraft's navigation system is working or not. Remember that.
cues.zh: 飞机系统启动并在 23 点 54 分通过 SATCOM 建立了连接，大约 1 分 20 秒后，它记录下了正如我刚才所说的副驾驶的输入操作。这表明该系统在这趟航班刚开始时工作正常，这里值得一提的是，该系统会根据飞机的导航系统是否正常工作来使用两个不同的卫星天线。记住这一点。

cues.en: As the first officer was working away in the cockpit, he soon received an ACARS message containing something known as a no-talk. Frequent viewers of this channel will know that this stands for notification to captain and is normally sent out if the aircraft would be carrying dangerous goods. In this case, there were actually no dangerous goods on board, just some special load being loaded consisting of several tons of mangosteens which apparently had a tendency to leak juice and water and therefore had to be checked closely.
cues.zh: 当副驾驶在驾驶舱里工作时，他很快收到了一条ACARS消息，其中包含一种被称为“no-talk”的内容。本频道的常客会知道，这代表“通知机长”，通常在飞机载有危险品时发送。而这次机上其实没有危险品，只是装载了一些特殊货物——几吨山竹，这些山竹 apparently 容易渗出汁液和水，因此必须仔细检查。

cues.en: The Nautog message confirmed that the cargo had been checked and that it wasn't leaking, but what it didn't say was that there were also nearly two and a half tons of lithium-ion batteries loaded on board. But these batteries were individually packaged and stored in such a way that they were not considered dangerous goods. They have therefore been ruled out as a possible cause for what's about to happen.
cues.zh: Nautog消息确认货物已经过检查且没有泄漏，但消息中并未提及机上还装载了近两吨半的锂离子电池。不过这些电池是单独包装并以特定方式存放的，因此不被视为危险品。所以它们被排除在即将发生之事可能原因的考虑之外。

cues.en: Eventually, the captain returned from his walk around and together with his colleague, they completed the rest of the pre-flap preparations and briefings. At time 23, 25, the first officer called up Kuala Lumpur delivery to request their departure clearance. The delivery controller told them that they were cleared to follow the P-Bus 1 Alpha departure from runway 32R and initially climbed to 6000 feet with transponder code 2157.
cues.zh: 最终，机长绕机检查归来，与同事一起完成了剩余的起飞前准备和简报。23点25分，副驾驶呼叫吉隆坡放行，请求起飞许可。放行管制员告知他们，已获准从32R跑道沿P-Bus 1 Alpha离场程序起飞，初始爬升至6000英尺，应答机代码2157。

cues.en: This was read back by the first officer and less than two minutes later Malaysia 370 also requested push and start which was almost immediately approved. After the pushback the aircraft received its taxi clearance and then started taxiing out towards runway 32 right through the dark Malaysian night. And for anyone watching the aircraft everything looked completely normal but this was going to be the last time anyone saw this aircraft with their own eyes.
cues.zh: 副驾驶复诵了指令，不到两分钟后，Malaysia 370 也申请推出并启动引擎，且几乎立刻获得了批准。推出完成后，飞机收到了滑行许可，随即穿过马来西亚漆黑的夜色，开始滑向 32 号右跑道。在旁人看来，这一切都再正常不过，但这却是所有人最后一次亲眼目睹这架飞机。

cues.en: So, what about the passengers then? Well, there were 227 passengers on board, coming from 14 different nations. 153 were from China, making those the largest group, followed by 50 from Malaysia and 7 from Indonesia. Two of those passengers were later found to have been flying on stolen passports. They were identified as Iranians, who were most likely looking for refugee status and were not considered a threat.
cues.zh: 那么，乘客的情况又是如何呢？机上共有 227 名乘客，来自 14 个不同的国家。其中 153 人来自中国，是人数最多的一群，其次是 50 名马来西亚人和 7 名印度尼西亚人。后来发现其中有两名乘客使用的是冒用护照登机。经核实，他们是伊朗人，大概率只是为了寻求难民身份，并未被视作安全威胁。

cues.en: None of the other passengers raised any type of suspicion, and this means that in total there were 239 passengers and crew on board when the giant Boeing 777 lined up on runway 32 right and started spooling up its engines. cues.en: The first officer was at the controls at this point and had therefore handed over the radio to the captain and after the engines were stabilised he pushed the toga buttons and the aircraft started accelerating down the runway. At 42 minutes past midnight the SATCOM system recorded that the aircraft was airborne and it then continued to transmit the aircraft's identification codes together with all of the other normal data and this just showed that everything was completely normal at that stage.
cues.zh: 此时副驾驶在操纵飞机，因此已把无线电通讯交给机长；发动机稳定后，他按下 TOGA 按钮，飞机开始沿跑道加速。午夜过后 42 分钟，SATCOM 系统记录到飞机已升空，随后持续发送飞机识别码以及所有其他正常数据，这表明当时一切完全正常。

cues.en: The procedures in Kuala Lumpur was for the pilots to automatically switch over to the departure frequency after takeoff, so that's exactly what the captain now also did. Once he called up and identified himself the departure controller told them to cancel the standard instrument departure and instead proceed direct towards a waypoint called Igari and continue the climb to flight level 180.
cues.zh:
吉隆坡的程序要求飞行员在起飞后自动切换到离场频率，所以机长现在做的正是这件事。
@@
一旦他呼叫并表明身份，离场管制员就告诉他们取消标准仪表离场程序，改为直接前往一个名为Igari的航点，并继续爬升到180飞行高度层。

cues.en: It's pretty common that controllers give clearances like this, especially at night when there's typically less traffic and therefore easier to give these kind of directs. The captain just read back the clearance and then selected Igari as the active waypoint in the FMC. The first officer would have then verified it, told him to execute the routing and then selected flight level 180 in the mode control panel for the captain to verify, just like they would have done thousands of times before.
cues.zh:
管制员给出这样的放行指令是很常见的，特别是在夜间，通常交通流量较小，因此更容易给出这类直飞指令。
@@o
机长复诵了放行指令，然后在 FMC 中将 Igari 选为当前航路点。
@@o
接着副驾驶会进行确认，让她执行该航线，然后在模式控制面板上选定 180 飞行高度层供机长确认，就像他们以前做过成千上万次那样。

cues.en: At this stage of the flight, everything was still completely normal and when you listen to the ATC tapes, the voice level of the captain is completely relaxed and routine. The aircraft continued its climb towards Gagari and they were eventually changed over to the next frequency, Lumper radar on 132.6. This was going to be the controller looking after them until they reached Gagari and the FIR boundary towards Vietnam.
cues.zh: 在飞行的这个阶段，一切仍然完全正常，当你听空管录音时，机长的语调完全轻松且例行公事。飞机继续爬升前往 Gagari，最终他们被移交给下一个频率，即 132.6 的 Lumper 雷达。这将是负责照顾他们的管制员，直到他们到达 Gagari 以及朝向越南的飞行情报区边界。

cues.en: The captain read back this handover more or less exactly as he should by confirming the new frequency and giving his call sign again sounding completely normal. When he called up the new area controller he was told that they could continue their climb to flight level 250 which he also read back and only three minutes later they received further clearance to climb to their requested cruise level flight level 350.
cues.zh: 机长几乎完全按照标准要求复诵了这次移交，确认了新频率并再次报出呼号，听起来完全正常。当他呼叫新的区域管制员时，被告知可以继续爬升至 250 号飞行高度层，他也对此进行了复诵，仅仅三分钟后，他们得到了进一步许可，可以爬升至他们要求的巡航高度层 350 号飞行高度层。

cues.en: As flight 370 progressed up towards the northeast, they were still fully visible on radar for all involved ATC units and here it's probably a good time to start explaining a bit about radars in general. There are two different types of radar to keep in mind for this episode. Primary radar, which is also referred to as raw radar and secondary radar. Under normal circumstances commercial air traffic always uses both of them, but the secondary radar is what gives the majority of the information.
cues.zh: 随着 370 航班向东北方向飞行，所有相关的空管单位在雷达上依然能完全看到他们，现在大概是开始解释一些关于雷达一般知识的好时机。本集需要记住有两种不同类型的雷达。主雷达，也被称为原始雷达，以及二次雷达。在正常情况下，民用航空交通总是同时使用这两种雷达，但二次雷达提供了大部分的信息。

cues.en: It is dependent on a small radio transmitter known as a transponder on board the aircraft and this transponder will be identified by a four-letter numerical code with numbers from 0 to 7. Remember, that was the code that the first officer received earlier as part of the departure clearance. Now, there are two transponders on board the aircraft and the active one will, when it's activated by the pilot, send air traffic control loads of information like position, altitude, speed and even MCP selections in some cases.
cues.zh: 它依赖于飞机上一个被称为应答机的小型无线电发射器，这个应答机将由一个四位数字代码识别，数字范围从 0 到 7。记住，这就是副驾驶员早先在离场许可中收到的那个代码。现在，飞机上有两个应答机，其中处于激活状态的一个，当被飞行员启动时，会向空中交通管制发送大量信息，比如位置、高度、速度，甚至在某些情况下还包括 MCP 选择。

cues.en: The transponders also communicates with other traffic and therefore enables TCAS maneuvering and it's these transponders that makes apps like Flight Raider 24 work since anyone can pick up the ADS-B signals that they transmit. But the key thing to remember here is that the transponders are on board the aircraft and without them functioning, Secondary Raider will not work and neither will those websites or TCAS.
cues.zh: 这些应答机还会与其他交通工具进行通信，从而实现 TCAS 避让机动；正是这些应答机让 Flight Raider 24 这样的应用得以运行，因为任何人都可以接收它们发射的 ADS-B 信号。但这里需要记住的关键点是，应答机是在飞机上的，如果没有它们正常工作，二次雷达将无法工作，那些网站或 TCAS 也是如此。

cues.en: And this brings us to the primary radar, which is an invention that has been with us for a very long time by now. In its essence, it works on a simple idea of sending out a radio pulse and then measuring any waves that might hit a target and then bounce back to the receiver. The direction those returning waves are then coming from will give a bearing to watch the target.
cues.zh: 这就把我们带到了一次雷达，这是一项已经伴随我们很久的发明。从本质上讲，它的工作原理很简单：发射无线电脉冲，然后测量击中目标并反弹回接收器的任何波。这些返回波传来的方向就能提供观察目标的方位。

cues.en: Obviously, this technology has become much more refined since it was first invented, making it much more complex, but you get the general idea. This type of radar can be used to see things that are not transmitting any information voluntarily and is therefore often used by the military. But given the nature of short-wave radio signals, this type of radar has a quite limited range and cannot accurately track altitude and speed very well, something that will become important soon.
cues.zh: 显然，这项技术自最初发明以来已经变得更加完善，复杂度也大大提升，但你大概能理解这个意思。这种雷达可以用来探测那些没有主动发射任何信息的物体，因此常被军方使用。但鉴于短波无线电信号的特性，这种雷达的探测距离非常有限，而且无法很好地精确追踪高度和速度，这一点很快就会变得很重要。

cues.en: At 1 minute and 14 seconds passed one in the morning, the captain on Malaysian flight 370 called up the Lumper area controller to advise him that they were now level at flight 350. This was acknowledged by the controller, but this was not a necessary call to make by the captain. It was more of a courtesy thing, but you could still hear from the sound of his voice that he was relaxed when he made this call, from the way that his intonation kind of dropped towards the end.
cues.zh: 凌晨1点14分，马来西亚航空公司370航班的机长呼叫吉隆坡区域管制员，通知他们飞机的巡航高度已稳定在350飞行高度层。管制员确认了这一消息，但其实机长没必要打这个电话。这更像是一种礼貌性的通话，不过你仍然能从他的语调中听出，他在打这个电话时非常轻松，因为他的语调在句尾微微下沉了。

cues.en: And it's from here on that I have a feeling that we can see the first indication of something being slightly out of order. Now, I want to make it absolutely clear that nothing in the final report has highlighted that whatever happened started as early as here, but I personally reacted to something that was just briefly mentioned in the report. You see, about seven minutes after the captain called in that they were leveled at light of a 350, he called up again and reported the very same thing.
cues.zh: 也就是从这里开始，我感觉我们能看到第一处略显异常的迹象。现在，我要明确指出，最终报告中的任何内容都没有强调无论发生了什么，其起点会这么早，但我个人对报告中一笔带过的一个细节产生了反应。你看，就在机长通报飞行高度达到350的七分钟左右后，他又一次呼叫并汇报了完全相同的事情。

cues.en: In the report, this was highlighted as anomalous, but the experts didn't think that it was worth paying any attention to, but I disagree. You see, we pilots tend to make these extra calls for two different reasons. The first is that we have just simply forgotten about it and therefore call again just to be on the safe side, but like I said earlier, this was not a mandatory call to make. The other reason we do it is because we've been away from the frequency for a while, maybe because we have been
cues.zh: 报告里把这一点标为异常，但专家认为不值得关注，我不同意。你看，我们飞行员会多打这类呼叫，通常有两个原因。第一是我们单纯忘了，所以为稳妥起见再呼叫一次，但像我之前说的，这并不是强制呼叫。另一个原因是我们有一阵没守频率了，也许是因为我们一直在

cues.en: fiddling with the radios or turn down the volume or something else and we just want to make sure that ATC hasn't tried to call us while we were gone. You see if we make that call again and ATC just responds Roger or something similar well then we know that they haven't been trying to call us because if they would have they would now repeat any other messages that they had previously tried to send. So with that in mind
cues.zh: 摆弄无线电、调低音量或干别的，我们只想确认 ATC 在我们离开时有没有试着呼叫我们。你看，如果我们再呼叫一次，ATC 只回一句 Roger 或类似的话，那我们就知道他们没试着呼过我们，因为如果呼过，他们现在就会重复之前想发的其他消息。所以考虑到这一点

cues.en: There were seven minutes between the first call and the second call, which means that something might have happened to take the captain away from the radio between those calls. The other thing that I reacted to was the tone of voice of the captain when he made that second call. Again, the experts in the report said that they couldn't detect any stress in the voice from the recordings, but what I am hearing is a clear difference in pitch between the first and the second call.
cues.zh: 第一次呼叫和第二次呼叫之间隔了七分钟，这意味着在这两次呼叫之间可能发生了什么事，让机长离开了无线电。另一个让我有反应的是机长第二次呼叫时的语气。报告里的专家又说，他们从录音里听不出声音中有任何紧张，但我听到的是第一次和第二次呼叫之间音高有明显差异。

cues.en: In the first the captain sounds relaxed with a clear dropping intonation towards the end and in the second he just sounds busy, like he's working on something at the same time that he's making that call. This, the sound of workload, is something that I often hear in the simulator as well as when I'm doing training in the aircraft and that's why I reacted to it when I heard it. Anyway, as expected the controller just responded with...
cues.zh: 在第一段里，机长的语气听起来很放松，句尾有明显的降调；而在第二段里，他听起来只是很忙，就像他在打电话的同时还在处理别的事情一样。这种工作负荷的声音，我在模拟器里以及在飞机上进行训练时经常听到，这也是我听到它时产生反应的原因。不管怎样，不出所料，管制员的回应是……

cues.en: This doesn't have to mean anything and I don't want to speculate any further on this detail but I thought it was worth to highlight given what's soon about to happen. So the aircraft continued its cleared track up towards Igarri and within minutes of that last call from the captain the A-Cars sent out its last complete routine message via SATCOM down to the ground station. After this there would be a complete silence from the aircraft SATCOM for almost 1 hour and 17 minutes.
cues.zh: 这并不一定意味着什么，我也不想对这个细节做过多的猜测，但考虑到即将发生的事情，我认为把它指出来是很有价值的。于是，飞机继续沿获准的航线向伊加里（Igarri）飞去，在机长最后一次呼叫后的几分钟内，ACARS通过卫星通信（SATCOM）向地面站发出了最后一条完整的例行报文。此后，飞机的卫星通信将彻底沉寂，持续近1小时17分钟。

cues.en: This detail is super important because it tells us a lot about what likely happened in the cockpit, but I'll get back to that soon. At time 01, 19 and 24 seconds, the Lumper Area Controller instructed Malaysian Airlines flight 370 to contact Huchimin control on frequency 120-9.
cues.zh: 这个细节超级重要，因为它向我们透露了大量关于驾驶舱内可能发生的事情的信息，不过我很快就会讲到这一点。在01点19分24秒，吉隆坡区域管制中心（Lumper Area Controller）指示马来西亚航空370号航班在120.9的频率上联系胡志明管制。

cues.en: This happened about one minute before the aircraft flew past Iguari, so they were still technically in Malaysian airspace, but would soon pass into Vietnam. And this is where the very last radio transmission occurred from flight 370, with the captain simply answering. Now, for some people that might have sounded like an omnis farwell, but what I heard was once again someone who was busy, so busy in fact, that he didn't complete the readback correctly.
cues.zh: 这发生在飞机飞过伊加里（Iguari）前大约一分钟，所以从技术上讲他们仍然在马来西亚领空，但很快就会进入越南。370航班的最后一次无线电通信就是在这里发出的，机长只是简单地回答了。现在，对某些人来说，这听起来可能像是一句客套的告别，但我听到的依然是一个很忙碌的人——实际上是忙得不可开交，以至于他没有正确完成复诵。

cues.en: Like I mentioned before, all frequencies we are given must always be read back to avoid mistakes, but that was not done in this call. In any case, now things started happening very quickly. Five seconds after the aircraft flew past the gari, the mode S functionality of the transponder, that was the part that gives that extra information, was suddenly switched off. Now, the only way to switch off only that is to turn the transponder knob in the cockpit from TARA to...
cues.zh: 就像我之前提到的，我们收到的所有频率都必须复诵以防出错，但这次通话中并没有照做。不管怎样，接下来事情发生得非常快。飞机飞过 gari 五秒后，应答机提供额外信息的 Mode S 功能突然被关闭了。而单独关闭该功能的唯一方法，就是把驾驶舱内的应答机旋钮从 TARA 拧到……

cues.en: the altitude of position. A technical malfunction would have removed all signals completely and immediately but in this case it took another 37 seconds for the secondary radar return to completely disappear and as it did the aircraft abruptly stopped following the planned route.
cues.zh: 高度位置。如果是技术故障，所有信号都会立刻彻底消失，但这次又过了 37 秒，二次雷达回波才完全消失，与此同时，飞机突然停止按预定航线飞行。

cues.en: We know this because the primary radar recorded a turn and what it registered was that after the initial right turn towards a point called Beto, the aircraft now started a sharp almost 180 degree left turn instead. Now Boeing tried to replicate this turn in the simulator but weren't able to match up the turn and the timings perfectly. The only simulation that got close included a manually flown turn meaning that the autopilot must have been disconnected.
cues.zh: 我们之所以知道这点，是因为一次雷达记录下了一次转向：数据显示，飞机在最初右转飞向 Beto 点后，反而开始向左进行了一次接近 180 度的急转弯。Boeing 曾尝试在模拟机上复现这一转弯，但无法在转向轨迹和时间节点上完全吻合。唯一接近的模拟包含了人工手动转弯，这意味着自动驾驶仪当时必定已经被断开了。

cues.en: And why is that you might ask? Well, the autopilot will only allow certain bank angles and this turn was so tight that a much steeper bank must have been used at least partially throughout the turn in order to accomplish it. The only reasonable conclusion that can be drawn from this is that someone had now started interfering with the flight's trajectory on purpose. The timing and position of where all of this took place also looks far from random.
cues.zh: 你可能会问，这是为什么呢？因为自动驾驶仪只允许特定的倾斜角度，而这次转弯半径极小，整个过程中至少有一部分必须采用大得多的坡度才能完成。由此能得出的唯一合理结论就是，有人当时开始故意干预飞机的飞行轨迹。而且这一切发生的时间和地点，看起来也绝非偶然。

cues.en: Igari was the point just before the FIR boundary between Malaysia and Vietnam, which meant that the controller from a new country would now be taking over the responsibility for the flight. The Malaysian controller, which formally still had the responsibility, had handed the aircraft over and therefore probably didn't monitor it too closely. And the new Hoshimin controller would likely wait until the aircraft called him up before starting to pay much attention to it, which is also exactly what now happened.
cues.zh: Igari正好位于马来西亚和越南FIR边界的交界点前，这意味着将由一个新国家的管制员接管这架航班的责任。马来西亚管制员虽然名义上仍负有责任，但已经移交了飞机，因此可能没有太密切地监控它。而新的Hoshimin管制员很可能要等到飞机主动联系他之后才会开始密切关注，这也正是当时发生的情况。

cues.en: Given this, it was the perfect place to initiate this maneuver if the intention was to try to avoid detection. And now you might ask, why disengage the autopilot? Why not just complete the turn? Well, just to the north of Igari, Thailand has something known as an air defense identification zone, which on a high level chart shows up as two dotted parallel purple lines.
cues.zh: 鉴于此，如果意图是试图避免被探测，这里正是启动该机动动作的完美地点。现在你可能会问，为什么要断开自动驾驶？为什么不直接完成转弯？嗯，就在Igari以北，泰国有一个所谓的防空识别区，在高空航图上显示为两条平行的紫色虚线。

cues.en: As the name suggests, the Thai military would be monitoring any traffic entering into that zone and follow it up, unless it was properly identified, had a working transponder and followed a filed flight plan. By carefully avoiding that zone, whoever was now in control would also avoid any direct scrutiny from the Thai military and given the direction the aircraft was now turning, it's likely that anyone looking at the primary radar would assume that the aircraft was just diverting, still under Malaysian control.
cues.zh: 顾名思义，泰国军方会监控任何进入该区域的飞行活动并对其进行跟踪，除非该飞行器被正确识别、拥有正常工作的应答机并遵循已提交的飞行计划。通过小心避开该区域，无论现在是谁在操控，都能避免泰国军方的直接监视；而考虑到飞机当时的转弯方向，任何查看一次雷达的人都很可能会认为飞机只是在改航，仍处于马来西亚管制之下。

cues.en: This turn would also position the aircraft between that Thai ADI-Z and Airway Mike 765 which would avoid any opposite traffic. This shows us that whoever was now in control was likely very well versed with the airspace structure over this particular area and that this was likely very carefully planned out.
cues.zh: 这一转向还会让飞机位于那个泰国 ADI-Z 和 Mike 765 航路之间，从而避开任何对向交通。这表明此时掌控飞机的人很可能非常熟悉这一特定区域的空域结构，而且这很可能是经过精心策划的。

cues.en: After the U-turn was finished the aircraft continued in a semi-straight line down towards the southwest and a VOR beacon known as Victor Papa Golf near Penang in Malaysia. The track showed small deviations consistent with an aircraft being flown manually and not on autopilot. Since these radar echoes were only captured on raw radar it was impossible to get any reliable speed or altitude data from them.
cues.zh: 完成掉头后，飞机继续沿半直线向西南方向飞行，飞向马来西亚槟城附近一个名为 Victor Papa Golf 的 VOR 信标。航迹显示出小幅偏差，符合飞机由人工驾驶而非自动驾驶的情况。由于这些雷达回波仅被原始雷达捕捉到，因此无法从中获得任何可靠的速度或高度数据。

cues.en: It is possible that the aircraft descended slightly during this segment, mainly to gain a higher true airspeed as it was overflying Malaysia. This theory was further corroborated by the fact that a Selkum mobile mast on the island of Penang briefly detected a mobile phone signal, which was later confirmed to have come from the first office's phone.
cues.zh: 飞机在这一段可能略有下降，主要是为了在飞越马来西亚上空时获得更高的真空速。这一推测进一步得到了佐证：槟城岛上的一个 Selkum 移动通信基站曾短暂探测到一个手机信号，后来确认该信号来自副驾驶的手机。

cues.en: Those type of signals generally have a very limited vertical range, maximum around 30,000 feet and often much lower than that. But given that atmospheric conditions have huge impact on the range, it's very hard to speculate here. But since turning off the mobile phone is a checklist item in most airlines, this could indicate that the first officer was trying to communicate here. But no call signals ever came through and the signal was only detected for a very short while.
cues.zh: 这类信号的垂直覆盖范围通常非常有限，最高约 30,000 英尺，而且往往远低于这个高度。但考虑到大气条件对覆盖范围有巨大影响，这里很难做出推测。不过，由于关闭手机是大多数航空公司检查单上的一项内容，这可能表明副驾驶当时试图进行通信。但始终没有任何呼叫信号发出，而且该信号只被探测到很短一段时间。

cues.en: But what is really intriguing during this segment of the flight is another system that we have already talked about a little bit, which is the SATCOM system. You see, the SATCOM sends out regular interrogations every hour if no other information is being transmitted. And when the ground-based station tried to uplink an ACARS message at the time three minutes past two in the morning, it didn't receive any acknowledgement back from the aircraft SATCOM. So, what does that mean then? Well,
cues.zh: 但这段航程中真正有意思的是另一个我们已经稍微谈过的系统，也就是SATCOM系统。你看，如果没有其他信息传输，SATCOM每小时都会发出常规询问。当地面站在凌晨2点03分尝试上行发送一条ACARS消息时，它没有收到飞机SATCOM的任何确认回复。那么，这意味着什么呢？嗯，

cues.en: If the ACARS system was just switched off or failed, the link would still take place. It would just communicate the fact that ACARS wasn't working. And if the system was manually logged off from the cockpit, this would also be shown in that log. And because none of that happened, the most likely reason for this SATCOM loss was a power failure to the system itself. Now,
cues.zh: 如果ACARS系统只是被关掉了或出了故障，链路仍然会建立。它只会传达ACARS不工作这一事实。而如果系统是从驾驶舱手动注销的，这也会显示在日志中。而因为这些都没有发生，SATCOM丢失最可能的原因是系统本身断电了。那么，

cues.en: This system can be powered from several different electrical buses and from most of the aircraft's redundant power sources. So this fact has led some incredibly experienced Boeing 777 pilots, whose excellent work I will be linking to in the description by the way, to believe that whoever was in charge of the aircraft after that initial turn must have manually turned off all of those sources.
cues.zh: 这个系统可以由几条不同的电气总线供电，也可以由飞机大多数冗余电源供电。所以这一事实让一些极其经验丰富的波音777飞行员相信，在最初那个转弯之后掌控飞机的人，一定是手动关闭了所有这些电源。顺便说一下，我将在描述中链接他们出色的工作。

cues.en: This can be done by deselecting both the primary and backup generators from their buses using the buttons on the overhead panel. After that, the aircraft would react by trying to auto-start the APU in order to replace those systems, so the person in charge would then have to put the APU switch to on and then back off again to stop that auto-start from happening. If that would happen, that would then trigger the RAM Air Turbine.
cues.zh: 这可以通过使用头顶面板上的按钮，将主发电机和备用发电机都从其总线上取消选择来实现。之后，飞机会做出反应，尝试自动启动APU来替代这些系统，所以负责人随后必须把APU开关打到开，然后再打回关，以阻止自动启动发生。如果这发生了，那就会触发冲压空气涡轮。

cues.en: a rat to be activated either manually or automatically and it would start to provide electrical power for the most critical systems like primary flight displays, navigation displays and navigation equipment but not the autopilot. Hydraulic movement of the flight controls would not be a problem since both engines were still working and providing hydraulics so maneuvering the aircraft manually would still work perfectly fine.
cues.zh: 一个棘轮，可以手动或自动启动，开始为最关键的系统供电，比如主飞行显示器、导航显示器和导航设备，但不包括自动驾驶仪。飞行控制面的液压运动不成问题，因为两台发动机仍在工作并提供液压，所以手动操纵飞机仍然完全正常。

cues.en: Now, of course, removing the primary power sources in this way would cause everything else except emergency lighting to go black in the aircraft, and it's likely that this would make things very difficult for both the crew and the passengers in the back. And while we're on the subject of the passengers and crew, I want to point out here that we really have no idea about what actually happened to them.
cues.zh: 当然，以这种方式切断主电源，会导致飞机上除应急照明外的一切都陷入黑暗，这很可能让机组人员和后舱乘客都陷入极大困难。既然说到乘客和机组人员，我想在此指出，我们其实完全不知道他们到底遭遇了什么。

cues.en: Some theories have suggested that whoever was in charge might have depressurized the cabin in order to get everyone into their seats and keep them under control. This is possible to do by just opening the outflow valves manually while still keeping the air conditioning running. The fact that the air conditioning kept running would provide heating and make it bearable in the cockpit as it otherwise would become freezing cold almost immediately.
cues.zh: 一些推测认为，当时负责的人可能给客舱减压，以便让所有人回到座位上并保持受控。这可以通过手动打开外流阀、同时保持空调运行来实现。空调持续运行会提供供暖，让驾驶舱内还算能忍受，否则几乎会立刻变得冰冷刺骨。

cues.en: The passenger oxygen masks would then drop in the back, but the oxygen generators in the triple 7 would only last for about 22 minutes or so. But the oxygen cylinder, which is provided in the cockpit crew with oxygen, would last a full 27 hours, in case there is only one person using it, and it had, like I mentioned before, been topped up just that very morning.
cues.zh: 后舱的乘客氧气面罩会随之落下，但 triple 7 上的氧气发生器只能维持大约22分钟左右。而驾驶舱机组配备的氧气瓶，如果只有一人使用，可以持续整整27小时，而且就像我之前提到的，那天早上刚刚加满过。

cues.en: This means that if the cabin was kept unpressurized without descending, the passengers would become completely incapacitated once the oxygen generator stopped working. But whoever was still in the cockpit would be able to just continue to operate just fine.
cues.zh: 这意味着如果客舱在不下降的情况下保持不加压状态，一旦氧气发生器停止工作，乘客将完全失去行为能力。但任何仍在驾驶舱里的人都可以继续正常操作。

cues.en: The time of useful consciousness at 35,000 feet is about one minute, extending to a few minutes at 30,000 feet, and anyone subjected to those altitudes without supplemental oxygen would after that not be able to take any rational decisions and soon become unconscious. After that, if no oxygen would be provided, it would take another 20 minutes or so until death would occur. But like I said before,
cues.zh: 在 35,000 英尺高度，有效意识时间大约是一分钟，在 30,000 英尺时延长到几分钟，任何在该高度下没有补充氧气的人在此之后将无法做出任何理智的决定并很快失去知觉。此后，如果不提供氧气，大约再过 20 分钟左右就会死亡。但正如我之前所说，

cues.en: we don't know for a fact what happened and we won't know more until the aircraft is found, which is why it is so important that we continue the search. Now, flying an aircraft at these altitudes manually whilst possibly wearing an oxygen mask and with only rudimentary navigation available would be quite tiring and that's likely why the radar images were showing these small heading variations.
cues.zh: 我们并不确切知道发生了什么，在找到飞机之前我们不会了解更多，这就是为什么我们继续搜寻如此重要。现在，在这些高度手动驾驶飞机，可能戴着氧气面罩且只有最基本的导航可用，会相当疲劳，这很可能是雷达图像显示这些细微航向变化的原因。

cues.en: Anyway, at this stage the aircraft continued to be tracked by both civilian and military raw radar as it continued its way around the south of Penang where it started turning right through the Malacca Strait. There were temporary lapses in the radar coverage but all in all it painted a fairly clear picture of an aircraft flying in a controlled way and not in any way random. So why wasn't the aircraft intercepted or tracked more closely then?
cues.zh: 无论如何，在这个阶段，民用和军用原始雷达继续追踪这架飞机，它继续向槟城南部飞行，并在那里开始向右转穿过马六甲海峡。雷达覆盖虽然有暂时的中断，但总体而言，它勾勒出一幅相当清晰的画面：飞机是在受控状态下飞行的，绝非随机飞行。那么为什么当时没有对飞机进行拦截或更密切的追踪呢？

cues.en: Well, this was due to a combination of factors and misunderstandings between different air traffic control units and the operations controllers in Malaysia Airlines' headquarters. When the aircraft first disappeared from radar, it took around 20 minutes before the Hoshi Min controller called up the Malaysian controller to ask about where the aircraft actually was. Now, this was significantly longer than the standard five minutes. It should take before a query is sent, but like I mentioned before,
cues.zh: 嗯，这是多种因素综合导致的，源于不同空中交通管制部门之间、以及与马来西亚航空总部运控人员之间的沟通误解。当飞机最初从雷达上消失时，胡志明市的管制员过了大约 20 分钟才联系马来西亚管制员，询问飞机究竟在哪里。这显然远超了发出询问所需的标准 5 分钟时限，但就像我之前提到的，

cues.en: This happened at an intersection between two different countries in the middle of the night, so it's likely that the controllers were just dealing with other traffic and didn't monitor their strips too closely. When the Malaysian controller, who was still technically responsible for the flight, was made aware of the missing aircraft, he eventually contacted Malaysian Airlines, who confirmed that they could see the aircraft flying up through Cambodia. This meant that the air traffic controllers now started contacting their colleagues along the route at the aircraft.
cues.zh: 这件事发生在两国交界空域，又正值深更半夜，所以管制员很可能只是在忙着处理其他航班，没有仔细盯着飞行进程单。当严格来说仍对该航班负责的马来西亚管制员得知飞机失踪后，他最终联系了马来西亚航空，对方确认他们能看到飞机正飞经柬埔寨上空。这意味着空管人员开始联系这架飞机预定航路上的同行，

cues.en: was thought to be flying to see if they could get into contact with them. And this in turn meant that none of them saw the lonely, faint radar echo that was travelling southwest instead. It was later found out that the Malaysian Airlines tracking software was basing the position of the aircraft on predictions when it didn't receive any real data. And that's what had caused that initial confusion.
cues.zh: 试图与他们取得联系，看看是否有人能联络上飞机。而这反过来导致谁也没注意到，那个孤零零的微弱雷达回波实际上正在向西南方向移动。后来大家才知道，马来西亚航空的追踪软件在收不到真实数据时，是依靠算法推测来显示飞机位置的。这正是最初混乱的根源所在。

cues.en: Now the military did see the aircraft turning left after Agari, but since it wasn't violating any new airspace, they assumed it was just a normal air turnback and didn't raise any further alarms or send anyone up to intercept. It was only later, with the help of radar playbacks, that the picture of MH370's true path became clearer. After the aircraft had turned right up towards the northwest, it looked like it was heading towards a waypoint called Vampi.
cues.zh: 军方确实看到了飞机在经过 Agari 后左转，但由于并未侵犯新的空域，他们以为这只是一次正常的空中返航，并未发出进一步警报，也没有战机升空拦截。直到后来借助雷达回放，MH370 的真实航迹才逐渐清晰。飞机右转朝西北方向飞去后，看起来正飞往一个名为 Vampi 的航路点。

cues.en: The SATCOM system still had not logged on at this stage, so we can assume that the aircraft was still flying in a power-degraded state, possibly only with a ram air turbine as a power source, but even if that was the case, navigation would still not be a problem. The Victor Papa Gold VR was still well within range, meaning that the aircraft could use raw data navigation to find Wumpy, and the waypoint could also be displayed on the aircraft's navigation display, so whoever was flying could just point the nose towards it.
cues.zh: 此时 SATCOM 系统仍未登录，因此可以推断飞机仍处于降级供电状态飞行，可能仅靠冲压空气涡轮供电，但即便如此，导航依然不成问题。Victor Papa Gold VOR 导航台仍在有效覆盖范围内，意味着飞机完全可以利用原始数据导航找到 Wumpy，该航路点也能显示在飞机的导航显示屏上，操纵者只需把机头对准它飞即可。

cues.en: Wampi was soon passed and the now more and more faint radar echo continued flying up in the general direction of airway November 571 towards another waypoint called Meerkar. And it's soon after the aircraft passed slightly to the south of that waypoint at time 0-22 and 12 seconds that all conventional radar traces from this flight completely disappeared. Now there is a real possibility that there were military radars picking up signals from this aircraft for longer than this but
cues.zh: 很快飞机飞越了 Wampi，雷达回波虽然越来越弱，但仍大致沿着 November 571 航路方向，飞向另一个名为 Meerkar 的航路点。就在飞机于 0 点 22 分 12 秒从该航路点偏南侧飞过不久，该航班的所有常规雷达信号便彻底消失了。虽然军方雷达很有可能追踪这架飞机的时间比这更久，但是……

cues.en: Given the sensitivity around showing military capability or positions of mobile radars, we haven't seen any such information come forward. So this means that from this point onwards, we are now going into the unknown and with that comes speculation or hypothesis, which you all know I tried to avoid on this channel. So let's instead try to stay with what we do know.
cues.zh: 考虑到公开军方侦察能力或机动雷达阵地的敏感性，目前并未公布任何此类信息。这意味着从这一刻起，我们便进入了未知领域，随之而来的便是各种推测与假说，而大家也知道，我的频道一向尽量避免这些。所以，我们还是专注于目前已确知的事实。

cues.en: In order to further track this aircraft, the investigators, scientific community and several commercial companies had to start using any data they had received in completely new ways and a great example of this is the Inmarsat data. Inmarsat is, as the name suggests, a company providing satellite communication services and it was through their satellite that the SATCOM system for the aircraft A-Cars was operating.
cues.zh: 为了进一步追踪这架飞机，调查人员、科学界和几家商业公司不得不开始以完全崭新的方式使用他们收到的任何数据，其中一个很好的例子就是国际海事卫星组织（Inmarsat）的数据。顾名思义，Inmarsat 是一家提供卫星通信服务的公司，飞机 A-Cars 系统的卫星通信（SATCOM）正是通过他们的卫星运行的。

cues.en: The signals these satellites were sending were never designed to track aircraft, but since there were signals exchanged with damage 370, those signals could be reverse engineers to provide a crude singular position indicator every time that they appeared. The way this was done was basically by mimicking certain parts of the GPS system. You see, each GPS satellite is basically an extremely accurate timing device and when a device on earth like
cues.zh: 这些卫星发送的信号从来都不是为了追踪飞机而设计的，但由于有与马航 370 交换的信号，这些信号可以通过逆向工程，在每次出现时提供一个粗略的单一位置指示器。实现这一目标的方法基本上是模仿 GPS 系统的某些部分。你看，每个 GPS 卫星基本上都是一个极其精确的定时设备，当地球上的设备（比如

cues.en: your phone or in this case a Boeing 777 connects to one of them the GPS satellite transmits a quick signal which basically says this is where I am and this is the time right now. That signal then travels at the speed of light which still takes a certain amount of time to arrive to your device.
cues.zh: 你的手机，或者在本案中是一架波音 777）连接到其中一颗卫星时，GPS 卫星会传输一个快速信号，大意是：这是我的位置，现在是这个时间。然后该信号以光速传播，但这仍然需要一定的时间才能到达你的设备。

cues.en: That time is measured to determine how far away you are from that GPS satellite and with the satellite's position and your distance from it we can determine that you are somewhere along the radius of a circle. Then obviously your device will connect to multiple satellites with each one of them drawing its own circle and where all of these circles meet, well, that's where you are.
cues.zh: 系统会测量这段时间来确定你距离那颗 GPS 卫星有多远，结合卫星的位置和你的距离，我们就能确定你位于某个圆的半径上的某个位置。显而易见，你的设备会连接多颗卫星，每颗卫星都会画出它自己的圆，而所有这些圆交汇的地方，嗯，就是你所在的位置。

cues.en: So in the case of the Inmarsat data, this same technique could basically also be used. Each time the aircraft connected to the satellite using the SATCOM system, the time its system took to respond to the satellite signals was recorded. The same happened at regular intervals when the satellite checked that the plane was still connected and each of these connections, seven of them in total, are the famous handshakes that were reported about basically everywhere.
cues.zh: 所以对于Inmarsat（国际海事卫星组织）的数据来说，基本也可以使用这种相同的技术。每当飞机通过卫星通信系统连接卫星时，其系统响应卫星信号所花费的时间都会被记录下来。同样的情况也发生在卫星定期检查飞机是否仍然连接的间歇期，而这些连接（总共七次）就是基本上到处都在报道的著名的“握手”。

cues.en: Every one of those handshakes could then be used to place the missing aircraft somewhere along a circle at a specific point of time. And that process of defining a circle or arc is called burst timing offset or BTO. But this was not the only information that the Inmarset signals could provide. Analysts could also pick up another value in the signal, something known as burst frequency offset or BFO.
cues.zh: 每一次这样的“握手”都可以用来在特定的时间点将这架失踪的飞机定位在一个圆圈的某个位置上。而这种确定圆圈或弧线的过程被称为突发定时偏移，简称BTO。但这并不是Inmarsat信号能够提供的全部信息。分析人员还可以在信号中提取另一个数值，即所谓的突发频率偏移，简称BFO。

cues.en: BFO gave information that could help the investigators determine how the aircraft was moving in relation to the satellite. As its name suggests, it involved studying the actual frequencies of the signal that the satellite received and then how they differed from the expected frequencies. Think of this like the way an ambulance siren seems to change its tone as it drives towards you and then past you.
cues.zh: BFO提供的信息可以帮助调查人员确定飞机相对于卫星的运动状态。顾名思义，它涉及研究卫星接收到的信号的实际频率，以及它们与预期频率的差异。可以这样理解：这就像救护车的警报器在向你驶来又驶过你身边时，其音调似乎会发生变化一样。

cues.en: When it's coming towards you the sound waves are denser making for a higher frequency and after it goes past you the sound waves moves further apart giving the tone a lower frequency. This is called the Doppler effect or the Doppler shift and primary radars actually also use this in the same way to determine for example the speed of an aircraft. Now...
cues.zh: 当它向你驶来时，声波更密集，频率更高；而当它驶过你之后，声波彼此拉开距离，音调的频率就会变低。这被称为多普勒效应或多普勒频移，实际上主雷达也以同样的方式利用这一点来测定例如飞机的速度。那么……

cues.en: I am, of course, oversimplifying these concepts a bit here, but in the case of MH370, since these signals between the aircraft and the satellite traveled mostly vertically, the birth frequency offset, or BFO, was instead used to help investigators determine whether the aircraft was climbing or descending. Now, those of you who have been paying attention will have noticed that I have said that the SATCOM system was not working, so how could the in-mercet analysts get any of these handshakes?
cues.zh: 当然，我在这里对这些概念做了些简化，但就MH370而言，由于飞机与卫星之间的这些信号主要是垂直传播的，因此转而利用 Birth Frequency Offset（初始频率偏移，简称BFO）来帮助调查人员判断飞机是在爬升还是下降。现在，一直在留意听的人会注意到，我说过SATCOM系统当时并未工作，那么Inmarsat的分析人员是如何获取到这些握手信号的呢？

cues.en: Well, here's where we get to a really interesting development that happened at time 0.225 and 27 seconds. Then, all of a sudden, the previously non-responsive SATCOM system of MH370 suddenly came back to life and proceeded to start sending a logon request to the satellite. This would later be referred to as the first handshake.
cues.zh: 好了，这里就引出了一个非常有趣的进展，发生在时间0.225和27秒。然后，突然间，MH370先前无响应的SATCOM系统突然恢复了生机，并开始向卫星发送登录请求。这后来被称为第一次握手。

cues.en: This happened almost exactly one hour after the aircraft had completed its turn of Trigari and the interesting bit is that the burst frequency offset value in this first handshake was deemed unreliable due to a quite large frequency error. And what's making that so interesting then? Well, it turns out that the quartz crystals used in the SATCOM radio transmitters needed to be kept at a constant temperature to avoid big frequency oscillations.
cues.zh: 这几乎正好发生在飞机完成Trigari转向后的一小时，有趣的是，这次首次握手时的突发频率偏移值因较大的频率误差被认为不可靠。那么，这为何如此引人关注呢？原来，SATCOM无线电发射器中使用的石英晶体需要保持在恒定温度下，以避免大的频率波动。

cues.en: This was achieved with the help of something known as an oven controlled crystal oscillator, which was basically a temperature controller and it needed time to warm up after a lengthy power interruption. So it is likely that it hadn't reached the correct temperature at this point when the first logon message was sent, hence the BFO frequency error. And this is how we know that the aircraft was likely powered down up until just prior to this point. Science is
cues.zh: 这是通过一种称为恒温控制晶体振荡器的装置实现的，它基本上是一个温度控制器，在长时间断电后需要时间预热。因此，很可能在发送首条登录消息时，它尚未达到正确的温度，从而导致了BFO频率误差。这就是我们如何得知飞机很可能在此刻之前一直处于断电状态。科学真是

cues.en: truly amazing. Now this first handshake also lacked a valid flight and company ID, which the aircraft previously had transmitted correctly. We cannot note this for sure, but if the aircraft's power had been manually restored at this point, well then the person in command would likely also know that the SATCOM system would soon boot up and start sending out data. So in order to stay hidden,
cues.zh: 令人惊叹。这次首次握手还缺少有效的飞行和公司ID，而飞机先前曾正确传输过这些信息。我们无法确定这一点，但如果飞机的电源此时被手动恢复，那么指挥者很可能也知道SATCOM系统很快会启动并开始发送数据。因此，为了保持隐蔽，

cues.en: He would have had to manually go into the multifunctional display and disable all communications through the communications manager page. Before the satellite communication unit, the SDU, became fully operational. If this was done this way, this would also raise the flight and company info, which is exactly what the data also showed.
cues.zh: 他不得不手动进入多功能显示器，并通过通信管理器页面禁用所有通信。在卫星通信单元SDU完全投入运行之前。如果这样做了，这也会抹去飞行和公司信息，而这正是数据显示的情况。

cues.en: So you can see, even though no data was actually sent out, with a lot of ingenuity, the signals themselves can actually tell us a lot about what was likely going on. We also know, for example, that the navigation system was working because of which antenna the SATCOM system was using when it started transmitting. Like I said, amazing.
cues.zh: 所以你可以看到，尽管实际上并没有数据被发送出去，但凭借许多巧思，这些信号本身就能告诉我们很多关于当时可能发生的情况。我们还知道，比如，导航系统当时在工作，因为我们可以从SATCOM系统开始传输时使用的是哪个天线看出来。就像我说的，很神奇。

cues.en: So using the Inmarsat data we know for sure that the aircraft continued to fly long enough to allow a total of seven handshakes where the first and the last were logon requests sent by the aircraft itself. Like I explained before these logon requests were most probably caused by power interruptions where the last one was likely caused by the fuel starvation of one or possibly both engines after the aircraft had flown for around 7 hours and 35 minutes.
cues.zh: 所以，利用Inmarsat数据，我们确信飞机继续飞行了足够长的时间，总共进行了七次握手，其中第一次和最后一次是飞机自己发送的登录请求。就像我之前解释的，这些登录请求很可能是由电源中断引起的，而最后一次很可能是飞机飞行了大约7小时35分钟后，一个或可能两个发动机燃油耗尽导致的。

cues.en: That last handshake came at time 0819 Malaysian time which corresponds quite well with the endurance of the aircraft based on the recorded fuel. Now these handshakes occurred roughly every hour since the system was sent to send out a ping every hour unless other SATCOM activities were initiated. Two of the handshakes were caused by ground-based satellite calls from the Malaysian Airlines Operations Center who reached the cockpit but was left unanswered. Even so,
cues.zh: 最后一次握手发生在马来西亚时间08:19，这与根据记录的燃油量推算的飞机续航时间相当吻合。现在，这些握手大约每小时发生一次，因为系统被设置为每小时发送一次ping，除非有其他SATCOM活动被发起。其中两次握手是由马来西亚航空运营中心发起的地面卫星呼叫引起的，他们联系到了驾驶舱，但无人应答。即便如此，

cues.en: they reset the hourly timing of the other handshakes and that's the reason why all of these seven handshakes were not happening on the same hourly intervals. But of course we now have a huge problem. Since the Inmarsat data was all coming from one satellite, the arcs created by these seven handshakes created multiple possible routes that the aircraft might have flown and therefore an enormous potential search area.
cues.zh: 它们重置了其他握手的每小时计时，这就是为什么这七次握手没有在相同的每小时间隔发生的原因。但当然，我们现在有一个巨大的问题。由于Inmarsat数据全部来自一颗卫星，这七次握手形成的弧线创造了飞机可能飞过的多条可能路线，因此形成了一个巨大的潜在搜索区域。

cues.en: Several hugely accomplished pilots and investigators have come up with very plausible scenarios on how the aircraft must have been flown after that last radar position to both align with all of those seven handshakes and avoid detection. Almost everyone agrees that the most likely route includes a turn from the previously north westerly course around the area of a waypoint called Nilam onto a more southwesterly course.
cues.zh: 几位非常资深的飞行员和调查人员提出了一些相当可信的推测，说明飞机在最后一个雷达位置之后是如何飞行的，才能既与那七次握手信号吻合，又避开探测。几乎所有人都认为，最可能的航线包括从原先的西北航向，在名为Nilam的航点附近转向，改走更偏西南的航向。

cues.en: This would bring it down past the northern tip of Indonesia, close to Bandarache, and some time after that it might have chosen a southerly course, straight down into the southern Indian Ocean. I will link to some incredible investigative work made by Captain Patrick Bleli and Jean-Luc Marchand in the description of this video, which lays out a very plausible final route.
cues.zh: 这样飞机就会飞过印度尼西亚北端，靠近Bandarache，之后某个时间可能转向南，径直飞入南印度洋。我会在视频简介中附上机长Patrick Bleli和Jean-Luc Marchand所做的精彩调查工作链接，其中给出了一个非常可信的最终航线。

cues.en: What I really want to do now is to also look at the possibility that there actually might be more physical evidence of where this aircraft finally ended up. All of the evidence that I've presented to you so far points to a deliberate action from someone on board with expert knowledge of the aircraft, its systems and the airspace it was flying through. But a question that has been nagging me is that would someone who has obviously planned this so thoroughly to avoid detection
cues.zh: 我现在真正想做的，是也看看另一种可能性：这架飞机最终坠落的地点，是否其实还有更多实物证据。到目前为止我展示的所有证据都指向机上某人的蓄意行为，此人对飞机、飞机系统以及所飞空域有专业知识。但一直困扰我的一个问题是：一个显然如此周密策划以避开探测的人，

cues.en: Bring the aircraft out to this point and then just turn the aircraft south and wait several hours until it ran out of fuel. It feels a bit unlikely given how active this person was during those initial parts of the maneuver and I wouldn't be surprised if he continued to be as active until the very end. But again, this will be hard to prove without further physical evidence. And it now looks like we might possibly have just that.
cues.zh: 会把飞机带到这个位置，然后只是把飞机转向南，等上几个小时直到燃油耗尽吗？考虑到此人在机动初期阶段如此活跃，这感觉有点不太可能，如果他一直活跃到最后，我也不会感到意外。但再次强调，没有更多实物证据，这很难证明。而现在看来，我们可能恰好就有了这样的证据。

cues.en: You see, back in 2008, an American astrophysicist by the name of Joseph Houton Taylor Jr. started working on something called the Weak Signal Propagation Reporter Protocol, or WISPR for short. He had previously received a Nobel Prize in physics back in 1993 for his work on pulsars, but he was also a keen amateur radio enthusiast.
cues.zh: 早在 2008 年，一位名叫 Joseph Houton Taylor Jr. 的美国天体物理学家开始研发弱信号传播报告协议（简称 WISPR）。他曾在 1993 年因脉冲星方面的研究获得诺贝尔物理学奖，但他同时也是一位狂热的业余无线电爱好者。

cues.en: WISPR is a protocol for low power radio transmissions that explores how low, medium and high frequency transmissions propagate over large distances and Taylor designed computer software that was used to analyze these signals. When these signals move over large distances they sometimes scatter when they hit obstacles in their path and this causes tiny anomalies in the signal strength.
cues.zh: WISPR 是一种低功耗无线电传输协议，用于探索低频、中频和高频信号在远距离下如何传播，Taylor 还设计了用于分析这些信号的计算机软件。当这些信号进行远距离传输时，有时会因撞击路径上的障碍物而发生散射，从而导致信号强度出现微小的异常。

cues.en: This was interesting for radio amateurs because they could sometimes use those obstacles to improve overall reception. And crucially, one feature in the WISPR protocol is that the reception from thousands of these signals have been uploaded into a shared database and stored all the way back to 2008. Now, I want to be absolutely clear here and say that Taylor himself never designed WISPR to be used for the tracking of aircraft. Neither did he actually think that it was possible.
cues.zh: 这对无线电爱好者来说很有意思，因为他们有时可以利用这些障碍物来改善整体接收效果。至关重要的一点是，WISPR 协议的一个特性就是将成千上万个这类信号的接收数据上传到一个共享数据库，数据记录一直追溯到 2008 年。不过，这里需要明确说明的是，Taylor 本人从未打算将 WISPR 用于追踪飞机，他实际上也不认为这行得通。

cues.en: But back in 2021, an avionics system engineer called Richard Godfrey started exploring the possibility of using the WISPR database together with algorithms to look for anomalies in several different simultaneous transmissions as a kind of poor man's primary radar. Theoretically, if you know the exact location of the transmitter and the receiver, together with the time of day and about a million other factors,
cues.zh: 但在 2021 年，一位名叫 Richard Godfrey 的航空电子系统工程师开始探索一种可能性：结合算法利用 WISPR 数据库寻找多路并发传输中的异常，作为一种“平民版”的一次雷达。从理论上讲，只要你知道发射端和接收端的精确位置，再加上具体时间以及其他成百上千个因素，

cues.en: there might be a possibility to use tiny, concurring anomalies in several of these signals to track something like an aircraft. And the really cool thing is that this technology samples thousands of signals every two minutes, which could potentially give us much more information than we previously had. Godfrey understood this, and from 2021 until today, he and his colleagues, Dr. Hannes Kuedse and Professor Simon Maskell, have been trying to analyze these...
cues.zh: 就有可能利用多个信号中同时出现的微小异常，来追踪像飞机这样的目标。最酷的是，这项技术每两分钟就会对数千个信号进行采样，这有望为我们提供比以往丰富得多的信息。Godfrey 意识到了这一点，从 2021 年至今，他和他的同事 Hannes Kuedse 博士以及 Simon Maskell 教授一直在尝试分析这些……

cues.en: database to try and find traces of MH370. And in a report released on the 31st of August 2023, they claim that they have actually done just that. Again, this video is not about whether this technology actually can be used this way or not. But what I find fascinating here is that it's based on verifiable stored data. So just like with DNA that couldn't be used much during the early years, but has since been refined to incredible accuracy,
cues.zh: 数据库来尝试寻找 MH370 的踪迹。在 2023 年 8 月 31 日发布的一份报告中，他们声称自己确实做到了这一点。再次说明，本视频并不是在讨论这项技术是否真的能以这种方式使用。但我觉得有意思的是，它基于可验证的存储数据。因此，就像早期无法大范围使用、但后来精度不断提高的 DNA 一样，

cues.en: maybe there actually is something hidden inside of these signals. This team's trace data have actually already improved significantly from their first results as their algorithms have been evolving and this latest report tells a quite fascinating story. Initially the whisper data coincided nicely with the existing radar information up until just prior to Vampy where it indicated that the aircraft made a turn to a more westerly heading.
cues.zh: 也许这些信号中真的隐藏着什么。随着算法的演进，这支团队的轨迹数据实际上已经比最初的结果有了显著改善，最新的一份报告讲述了一个非常引人入胜的故事。最初，这些微弱的信号数据与现有的雷达信息高度吻合，直到到达 Vampy 之前，数据显示飞机转向了更偏西的航向。

cues.en: It then paralleled the assumed track on a slightly more suddenly course than indicated by the raw radar and this could be because of the inherent impreciseness of the technology or the same from the radar, which at that point was at the very limit of its effective range. In any case, the Whisper track continued up towards the northwest where it intercepted exactly the arc from the first Inmarsat handshake at time 0-2, 28 and 15 seconds.
cues.zh: 随后，它平行于假设航线行驶，航向比原始雷达显示的稍微偏南一点，这可能是因为该技术固有的不准确性，或者是雷达本身的问题，当时雷达已经达到了其有效探测距离的极限。无论如何，这个微弱信号轨迹继续向西北方向延伸，准确地与 02 点 28 分 15 秒第一次 Inmarsat 握手信号的弧线相交。

cues.en: The data then indicates that the aircraft continued up towards a point known as Sarnob after which it made a left turn towards Urdam all very close to what the other experts predicted that the aircraft must have done to continue avoiding military radars and additional scrutiny by ATC. Now, I won't go into all of the details of the route that the WISPR data indicated, but I want to highlight a few important things.
cues.zh: 接着，数据表明飞机继续向北飞往一个叫作萨尔诺布（Sarnob）的点，随后向左转弯朝乌尔丹（Urdam）飞行，这与其它专家预测飞机为躲避军用雷达和空管（ATC）进一步盘查而必须采取的飞行路线高度吻合。好了，我不会逐一详述 WISPR 数据显示的航线细节，但我想要强调几个重要的点。

cues.en: This data pointed to a track that wasn't completely straight down into the southern Indian Ocean. Instead, it showed a series of turns, each of which was pointing towards an existing waypoint, but not ever on the same airway. This corresponds nicely with an aircraft that was still being piloted, but in a planned way to avoid interfering with existing airways where a potential traffic conflict could arise. Remember, it would not be seen on TCAS, nor could whoever was.
cues.zh: 这些数据指向了一条并非笔直深入南印度洋的航迹。相反，它显示了一系列连续的转弯，每次转弯都指向现有的航路点，但从不沿着同一条航线飞行。这非常符合由人工驾驶的飞机的特征，但其飞行是有计划的，旨在避免干扰可能产生冲突的现有航路。记住，它不会显示在 TCAS 上，驾驶它的任何人也无法。

cues.en: flying it see other traffic. If the intention was to not be detected this type of behavior would make perfect sense since its ultimate destination would be very hard to predict in case it was partially being monitored. The whisper data also suggested that the aircraft slowed down slightly during two different intervals of its jagged flight down towards the south which could possibly mean step climbs.
cues.zh: 看到其他交通情况。如果目的是不被侦测到，这种行为就完全合乎逻辑了，因为一旦它受到部分监控，其最终目的地将极难被预测。whisper 数据还表明，在它向南曲折飞行的过程中，有两个不同的时间段速度略有下降，这可能意味着阶梯式爬升。

cues.en: But the thing that really stood out to me was the fact that the whisper data corresponded almost perfectly with all of the seven Inmarsat handshake arcs which is data that no one is really disputing. Towards the end of the flight the whisper position also indicated something very strange. Because it looked like the aircraft started flying in a figure 8 pattern in between the sixth and the seventh handshake which would have been when the aircraft was predicted to be running out of fuel.
cues.zh: 但真正让我感到惊奇的是，whisper 数据与所有七条 Inmarsat（国际海事卫星组织）握手弧线几乎完全吻合，这些数据是几乎没有人有异议的。在飞行接近尾声时，whisper 的位置还显示了一个非常奇怪的现象。因为看起来飞机在第六次和第七次握手之间开始以“8”字形轨迹飞行，而这正是预测飞机即将耗尽燃油的时候。

cues.en: The aircraft wouldn't do that by itself, because the rather compensating system in the Boeing 777 is designed to compensate for the asymmetric thrust after an engine failure, so if this pattern was actually flown, it must have been a deliberate act by whoever was in control. Now, it is very hard to speculate on why someone would do something like that, but at this time it would have been daylight in that area and the weather was clear, so it is possible.
cues.zh: 波音 777 相当完善的补偿系统旨在补偿发动机失效后的不对称推力，因此飞机本身不会做出这种动作。如果这种航迹真的飞出来了，那一定是驾驶者的蓄意行为。现在，我们很难推测某人为什么要做出这样的举动，但在当时该地区是白昼且天气晴朗，所以这是有可能的。

cues.en: that this was done to look out for ships in the area nearby, as a reassurance that the aircraft's final resting place would not be seen. The BFO from the Inmarsat data indicated that the aircraft could have been in a very steep descent during the last logon handshake, as high as 14,500 feet per minute. But that doesn't necessarily mean that it just delves straight into the sea.
cues.zh: 这样做是为了留意附近区域的船只，确保飞机的最后长眠之地不被发现。来自 Inmarsat 数据的 BFO 表明，在最后一次登录握手期间，飞机的下降率可能非常陡峭，高达每分钟 14,500 英尺。但这并不一定意味着它就直接扎入了海中。

cues.en: Instead, again, according to the excellent report of Captain Blalie and Jean-Duc Marchand, there is the possibility that the right engine flamed out due to fuel starvation and that this led the person in charge to start the APU and open the crossfield valve to maximize the use of the remaining fuel.
cues.zh: 相反，根据 Captain Blalie 和 Jean-Duc Marchand 的优秀报告，还有这样一种可能：右侧发动机因燃油耗尽而熄火，这导致负责人启动了 APU 并打开了交输供油阀，以最大限度地利用剩余燃油。

cues.en: The APU standpipe sits a little bit lower in the tank than the engines does so that gives it a little bit more access to all available fuel and the person in command could then have manually shut down the remaining engine to maximize the APU use which would have given access to all flight controls and systems for as long as possible and also enable the flaps to be extended. It wouldn't be possible without either one engine or the APU running.
cues.zh: APU 的立管在油箱中的位置比发动机稍低一些，因此它能更多地利用所有可用燃油。随后，机组人员可能手动关闭了剩余的发动机，以最大程度地使用 APU——这将尽可能长时间地维持所有飞行控制系统和系统的运行，并使襟翼得以展开。如果没有一台发动机或 APU 在运行，这是无法做到的。

cues.en: When the last INMASAT logon was completed, it lacked information from, for example, the in-flight entertainment system, which is logical if the aircraft was being powered by only the APU, since systems like the IFE would then have been shed to prioritize more important systems. According to Captain Bleyli's calculations, the aircraft could have ended up either very close to the 7th archivist,
cues.zh: 当最后一次 INMASAT 登录完成时，它缺少了例如机上娱乐系统的信息，这很合乎逻辑，因为如果当时飞机仅由 APU 供电，那么像 IFE 这样的系统就会被切断，以优先保证更重要的系统。根据布莱利机长的计算，飞机最终可能非常靠近第七弧线，

cues.en: in a rapid dive or as far as 67 nautical miles further south if the aircraft was flown to maximize its glide and touch down with flaps 30 selected. The whisper data showed a possible last position at time 0.819 and 37 seconds and after that there were no more correlated anomalies found. We do know that the aircraft crashed in the ocean in or near the already searched area because both internal and external parts of the aircraft have been found.
cues.zh: 如果飞机以滑翔最大化并选择 30 度襟翼接地的方式飞行，它可能会处于急降状态，或者在更南达 67 海里的地方。微弱的数据显示，在 0.819 分 37 秒时可能存在最后一个位置，此后就没有发现更多关联的异常情况。我们确实知道飞机坠毁在已经搜寻过的区域内或附近的海洋中，因为已经找到了飞机的内部和外部部件。

cues.en: The confirmed piece of debris comes from a flaperon from the right-hand wing as well as multiple other components which are almost certainly coming from MH370. All of those pieces have been washed up along the coastlines of eastern Africa and islands around by currents that can be tracked back to this general area. And given that some of the debris found comes from inside of the aircraft, it is likely that it broke up upon impacts.
cues.zh: 这块被确认的残片来自右翼的襟副翼，以及几乎可以确定来自 MH370 的其他多个部件。所有这些碎片都被洋流冲到了东非海岸线及周边的岛屿上，而这些洋流是可以追溯到这一大致区域的。鉴于找到的一些残骸来自飞机内部，它很可能在撞击时解体了。

cues.en: This horrific story have already led to improvements in tracking commercial aircraft over oceans, longer life for emergency locator transmitters and better ATC procedures for tracking aircraft, but we can't lay this to rest before the wreckage is actually found. Again, this is why I created this video.
cues.zh: 这个可怕的故事已经促成了对海洋上空商用飞机追踪技术的改进、延长了紧急定位发射器的寿命，并改善了用于追踪飞机的空管程序，但在真正找到残骸之前，我们无法让这件事平息。再次说明，这就是我制作这个视频的原因。

cues.en: Linked below here in the description are two different theories outlining two new search areas outside of those already searched in the biggest search effort in aviation history. One of those theories are based on the skill and knowledge of two veteran 777 captains and the other on a widely contested new application of existing radio data, but data that has been recently proven to work following flights in other areas.
cues.zh: 下方描述链接里提出了两种不同的理论，指出了两个新的搜索区域，而此前在航空史上最大规模的搜寻中并未涵盖这些区域。其中一种理论基于两位资深 777 机长的技术与经验，另一种则基于对现有无线电数据的一种备受争议的新应用，但这些数据最近已在其他区域的飞行中被证明是有效的。

cues.en: I am not here to judge what is right or wrong. The only thing that I want to achieve is to get the search going again for the sake of the families left behind. So here are two relatively small new areas to search. Please get the boats out there and let's get to the bottom of this literally.
cues.zh: 我来这里不是为了评判对错。我唯一想达成的事，就是为了那些逝者的家属，让搜寻工作重新开始。所以，这里有两个相对较小的全新搜索区域。请把搜寻船只派出去，让我们彻底查明真相。
